data.name: Fauz
data.gender_notes: Fauz is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘fauzah’ meaning ‘to be victorious’ or ‘to succeed’. In Islamic history, Fauz is the name of a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) known for his bravery and unwavering faith. The name Fauz carries the meaning “Victorious, Successful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fauz usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious, successful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of triumph and success in one's spiritual journey.
data.etymology: Fauz belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious, Successful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fauz total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
